source_conclusions.evidence: All fixture rows begin at timestamp 1234. The unchanged SQL allows digit-only leading-zero text to sort numerically as 895001, before peer 895101. Padded, signed, fractional, nonpositive and unsafe IDs use fallback 9007199254740992; their parent and pending child keep physical seq order after the peer.
